original_metadata.title: For 0<q<1, u>0 and coprime n>=2,n prime>0, the n-fermion currents (4.4) realize the SL2(Z)-twisted charged q-difference module with central charges (n,n prime)
original_metadata.author: Mikhail Bershtein; Roman Gonin
original_metadata.source_title: Twisted Representations of Algebra of q-Difference Operators, Twisted q-W Algebras and Conformal Blocks
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The obligation is to construct the twisted Chevalley currents explicitly, although the lattice automorphism is simple only on the full lattice-mode algebra. The proof embeds the q-difference algebra through an index-n sublattice, identifies the restricted charged Fock module and splits a single Clifford current into residue classes, tracking fractional powers and normal-order scalar terms. This representation-theoretic construction is substantially beyond ordinary Lie/Clifford algebra qualifying material.

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: The complete first proof of Theorem4.1 was read: Fock uniqueness and general lattice modes3.4–3.5, standard fermion/charge decomposition3.6–3.12, sublattice character argument5.1–5.5 and the full current decomposition/normal-order correction5.6 (including5.12). Section3 expressly reviews earlier level-one constructions studied in [27], and the basic boson–fermion correspondence is credited to [34]. AppendixA’s regular-product definitions and fermion contraction A.3 were read and included. The new n-component mode projection and twisted central charges are explicitly derived, not asserted by a named representation theorem. Select the full charged fermion module, not the other bosonic realizations or subsequent W/conformal-block applications.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Exactly the nontrivial positive-slope branch of Theorem4.1: 0<q<1, u>0 with positive roots chosen, n>=2 and n prime>0 coprime, sigma=[[m prime,m],[n prime,n]] in SL2(Z). On the full charged n-fermion Clifford module F^{n psi}, the currents (4.4) and H_k^{tw} act as Diff_q with c=n,c prime=n prime and identify the module with M_u^sigma. M_u is the full charged level-one fermion module (direct sum of Fock charge sectors), so this does not assert that the whole space is a single irreducible F_u^sigma. The selected proof is the sublattice proof in Section5, with regular-product context; other bosonic realizations and conformal-block identities are excluded.
original_metadata.source_boundary_note: The full original Theorem 4.1 is retained; this stable item's selected difficult branch is the positive real nontrivial coprime slope recorded below. Its complete first author proof is included together with the actual index-n sublattice and Clifford-residue current construction, normal-order scalar correction, charged module decomposition, Lie-algebra and regular-product definitions. The second independent proof and bosonic/W-algebra applications are outside this packet.
